scope: 独立艺术字创作方法蒸馏支线；正式VPD主线保持原状
objective: 把别人的优秀字形作品蒸馏成能应用于全新汉字/词组的可操作创作方法，而不是单图修复、整体字体扭曲、SVG描摹、写规则冒充作品质量

segmented_source.source_type: research segmentation polygon annotations + original 400px images
segmented_source.copyright_warning: BCSS described research purposes; source licensing for commercial derivatives not verified; do not promote to commercial assets without rights check

targets.assessment: B and C are similar; source-derived profile does not show professional design uplift
C has overloaded joined masses and cluttered central negative spaces; quality no better than B; cannot count as transfer success

executed_method: Extract labelled per-stroke boundary polygons from public BCSS JSON source samples
Measure principal axis and 17 bins of normalized cross-sectional geometry widths per annotated single stroke
Select each target HanziWriter centerline's style-profile by nearest undirected stroke angle
Construct a target-specific Catmull–Rom centerline and synthesize independent width-controlled ribbon polygons; source pixels and source paths are NOT copied into the new characters

Run A: original HanziWriter target outline; B: same centerlines and same synthesis with constant thickness; C: same centerlines and width synthesis with source-measured width profiles; render inside Figma and inspect actual screenshots
negative_findings: Target-glyph structure and renderability are feasible, but the profile transfer alone is not sufficient for premium calligraphic aesthetics.
Stroke matching by orientation is insufficient for CJK component roles: hooks, dots, slants, horizontal terminal behavior and pressure direction are not interchangeable.
BCSS's two sample characters do not have proven common author/creative intent and are not the same author's family as 六島; this is pipeline proof, not a 六島 designer-creation-method transfer.
六島 large connected SVG masses cannot uniquely identify independent pen strokes or real pressure merely by bounding-box projection; never label static contour widths as actual pen-pressure recordings.

next_exact_experiment.first_gate: Acquire 3+ attributable, properly licensed artworks from a coherent designer/style family OR true per-stroke evidence for one professionally finished work; recover evidence of creative operations before testing unknown characters.
next_exact_experiment.design_change: Fit features conditional on CJK stroke role (横/竖/撇/捺/点/钩), glyph component topology and within-character negative space, rather than PCA angle alone.
next_exact_experiment.minimal_causal_test: Same unseen target, matched baseline budget: role-conditioned inferred method vs simple angle-conditioned R2; keep source and font-derived skeleton fixed. No model or taste claims without actual pixels and blind human decision.
next_exact_experiment.stop_condition: If same-author source or genuine stroke-role segmentation unavailable, state blocker; do not try random prompt or spin further font variants.

current_project_goal_progress: R2 has produced an inspectable negative causal contrast, but NO validated designer-method distillation
